name: qfd_chead_m5-m5-COMMIT
purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed qfd_chead-orph2-a75cb556b-lvt-tc-hm25 (qfd_chead, RTL a75cb556b, snapshot of 1 drifted files): same RTL, outline 52.68x103.656, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:orphans-2

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qwen_die_station #(.DW(508), .TAP(1), .SPLIT(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_station.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: station_exact
bench.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/qfd_chead_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/qfd_chead_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -o {RUN}/bench/b0 -P tb_qwen_die_station.N=20000 -P tb_qwen_die_station.NEG=0 -P tb_qwen_die_station.SPLIT=1 rtl/test/tb_qwen_die_station.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_station.sv && vvp {RUN}/bench/b0 | tee {RUN}/bench/b0.log && grep -q "^PASS" {RUN}/bench/b0.log
}
bench.note: [m5rr: run on the a75cb556b snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/qfd_chead_m5/src]

bench.name: station_negative
bench.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_1; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/qfd_chead_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/qfd_chead_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -o {RUN}/bench/b1 -P tb_qwen_die_station.N=20000 -P tb_qwen_die_station.NEG=1 -P tb_qwen_die_station.SPLIT=1 rtl/test/tb_qwen_die_station.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_station.sv && vvp {RUN}/bench/b1 | tee {RUN}/bench/b1.log && grep -q "^PASS" {RUN}/bench/b1.log
}
bench.note: [m5rr: run on the a75cb556b snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/qfd_chead_m5/src]

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_chead_m5/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_chead_m5/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_chead_m5 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qwen_die_station  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
